Welcome A Message From Our Executive Director

Welcome to the Union City Parking Authority website. The Parking Authority manages and maintains the on-street and parking facilities throughout the city. It is our mission to provide clean and safe parking for residents and visitors.

The Parking Authority staff is available to assist you with any questions or concerns you may have regarding parking in Union City. As a convenience to you, we have extended our hours on Monday until 6 PM and we are open on Saturdays until noon.

The Parking Authority is very active on social media and will often post changes to parking hours on Twitter. The UCPA Twitter account is also linked to our website so you can always receive the most up to date information available.

It is our hope to provide the best public service possible. If you have any suggestions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Our Mission About Us & How We Serve You

The mission of The Authority is the construction, provision and operation of off-street parking facilities, for the promotion of free traffic flow, relief of traffic congestion on the City's streets and improvement of conditions affecting the public safety and welfare.

Additionally, to the extent authorized by the governing body of the City, The Authority is responsible for the management and operation of on-street parking and related facilities through the use of parking meters and the Residential Permit Parking Program (RPP). The Authority is also responsible for the enforcement of applicable laws, ordinances and regulations as to the parking of vehicles. The Authority is self-sufficient with all revenues derived from on-street meters; management fees; summons fine sharing and rental income from off-street parking lots.

UCPA Hours of Operation

  • Hours
  • Holiday Schedule

The Authority operates twenty-four (24) hours per day seven days per week. It is the policy of the authority to maintain Administrative Office Hours.

  • Monday - 8:00AM to 6:00PM
  • Tuesday - 8:00AM to 4:00PM
  • Wednesday - 8:00AM to 4:00PM
  • Thursday - 8:00AM to 4:00PM
  • Friday - 8:00AM to 4:00PM
  • Saturday - 8:00AM to 12:00PM
  • Sunday - CLOSED

Union City Parking Authority will be closed on the following dates:

  • January 20, 2025 (Monday) – Martin Luther King Day
  • February 17, 2025 (Monday) – Washington's Birthday (President's Day)
  • April 18, 2025 (Friday) – Good Friday
  • May 26, 2025 (Monday) – Memorial Day
  • June 19, 2025 (Thursday) – Juneteenth
  • July 4, 2025 (Friday) – Independence Day
  • September 1, 2025 (Monday) – Labor Day
  • October 13, 2025 (Monday) – Columbus Day
  • November 4, 2025 (Tuesday) – General Election Day
  • November 11, 2025 (Tuesday) – Veteran's Day
  • November 27, 2025 (Thursday) – Thanksgiving Day
  • November 28, 2025 (Friday) – Day after Thanksgiving
  • December 24, 2025 (Wednesday) – Christmas Eve (1/2 day pm)
  • December 25, 2025 (Thursday) – Christmas Day
  • December 31, 2025 (Wednesday) – New Year's Eve (1/2 day pm)
  • December 1, 2026 (Wednesday) – New Year's Day
